description: This file defines the SerializerSession class within the Orleans.Serialization.Session namespace, handling contextual serialization information such as type codecs, known types, referenced objects/types, and resource management via reset and dispose methods.

classes.name: SerializerSession
classes.description: Encapsulates the context required during serialization, managing codecs, references, and disposal logic.

methods.name: SerializerSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with type codec, known types, and codec provider.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Performs a full reset, clearing referenced objects and types.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Invokes the disposal callback if set, cleaning up resources.
